title: fix(platform-objects): Setup's user screens show a user's real state, and the copy-password line only when one was generated

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置 → 用户的四处界面文案与布局：创建用户/设置密码的结果框只在生成了临时密码时才提示「立即复制」；用户详情页显示已保存的语言和封禁状态与原因；用户列表加「已封禁」「平台角色」两列；「语言」字段的说明改为它决定界面语言（四种语言包同改）。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 18.2.0 设置走查发现管理员看到的是错的或缺的状态：手输密码后仍被要求复制不存在的密码、被封禁的用户看起来正常、列表上认不出封禁用户和管理员、语言说明只说通知。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `platform-objects` 的 sys_user 元数据、详情页定义和翻译包，无契约、无存储、无接口变化；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`（结果框与列表列）、`packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`（Details 分区）、`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/identity/create-user-result-dialog-copy.test.ts src/pages/sys-user-details-tab.test.ts src/identity/sys-user-list-status-role-columns.test.ts src/identity/sys-user-locale-help.test.ts`，预期 4 个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One commit per card, all on the platform's own `sys_user` metadata in `@objectstack/platform-objects`:

1. **#27858 — Create User / Set Password result.** Both result dialogs drop their dialog-level `description` ("If a temporary password was generated, copy it now — it is shown only once and never stored."). `ActionSchema.resultDialog` has no per-outcome copy, so that sentence showed on both outcomes, including a typed password, where nothing was generated. The instruction is now the label of the `temporaryPassword` field ("Temporary password: copy it now, it is shown only once and never stored"). The dialog skips a field whose path is absent from the response, and the endpoint returns `temporaryPassword` only when it minted one, so the line shows exactly when there is a password to copy. The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES packs carry the same change (description leaves dropped by `pnpm i18n:extract`, field labels translated by hand).
2. **#27859 — user record, Details tab.** The details renderer draws only authored sections, and none named `locale`, while `banned`, `ban_reason` and `ban_expires` were in `hideFields`. `locale` joins the Identity section, and a new Account Status section (inline labels in all four locales) carries `banned`, `ban_reason` and `ban_expires`.
3. **#27863 — Users list.** `all_users` gains `banned` and `role` columns after `email_verified`.
4. **#27869 (part) — Locale help.** `sys_user.locale`'s help now says it is the language the user sees the interface in as well as their notifications (the console applies it to the whole UI through `useUserLocale`). Source and all four shipped packs.

### What this PR does not carry, and who does

- **#27869 stays open (`Part of`).** Seat ruling in the seat-1 thread: (a) the English "Invalid password" refusal is a `plugin-auth` refusal, and it goes with #27857's PR; (b) French `sys_user` labels need French as a fifth platform locale (platform-objects ships en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES only, and HotCRM declares the same four), and the silent fallback is `service-i18n`'s. Both are reported as findings for the seat to file.
- **The role label (#27859 / #27863 "reads through its label").** `sys_user.role` stays `Field.text`, so the highlight and the new Role column show the stored value (`user`, `admin`). A label needs `Field.select`, which changes the column the SQL driver emits (`text` gives TEXT; `select` falls to the default `varchar(255)`), and `schema-drift` would read existing deployments as a `narrow_varchar`. Seat ruling A: this half is carried by its own card, which the seat files at ACCEPT.

## Tests

- New pins: `sys-user-list-status-role-columns.test.ts` (#27863), `sys-user-locale-help.test.ts` (#27869). Rewritten: `create-user-result-dialog-copy.test.ts` (#27858, both actions, all four packs). Extended: `sys-user-details-tab.test.ts` (#27859).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: Test Files 102 passed (102), Tests 1445 passed (1445). `typecheck`: exit 0.
- Ablations (one per row, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards):
  - #27858: `set_user_password` regains a `description` → `set_user_password: no dialog-level description` red (1 failed / 8 passed).
  - #27859: `locale` dropped from the Identity section → 2 failed / 3 passed.
  - #27863: `banned`, `role` dropped from `all_users` → `pins the default list columns` red (1 failed / 1 passed).
  - #27869: the old notifications-only source help restored → `the source description names the interface` red (1 failed / 4 passed).

## Acceptance notes

- The role label half (above) and #27869's (a) and (b) halves are reported in the card report for the seat to file or carry.
- `role` in the new list column reads the raw stored value until the role-label card lands.
